caption: The drawing depicts a folded textile object, likely a shawl or scarf, predominantly beige or off-white in color, with intricate woven or embroidered patterns. Below this red band, there is an additional horizontal decorative border incorporating an interlocking scrollwork motif. The textile ends with a fringe of long, off-white threads at the bottom. The entire composition is rendered against a plain, neutral background.
